description: K₃Na₈FeH₁₂S₆(NO₁₈)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of three K₃Na₈FeH₁₂S₆(NO₁₈)₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. K is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and  a faceface with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.35 Å) and three longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.87 Å. Fe is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Fe-O bond lengths are 2.03 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-57°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.54 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one N atom.
